mutants.label: remove the non-string choice ID guard
mutants.find: if not isinstance(choice_id, str) or choice_id not in valid_ids:
mutants.why: List and object IDs must return validation errors so the public retry and fallback paths complete; the tests supply these responses through a recording model client.

mutants.label: raise KeyError when choice_id is missing
mutants.why: A missing choice_id must remain a regular validation error that enters the existing retry path.

mutants.label: add a local set type annotation
mutants.replace: valid_ids: set[str] = {option["id"] for option in options}
mutants.why: A local variable annotation does not change set construction or runtime validation behavior.
